question: Which of the following calculations is correct?
solution: \((-2)+5\): when adding numbers with opposite signs, use the sign of \(5\) (positive), and \(5-2=3\). The other three equations have incorrect signs or values: \((-5)+3=-2\), \((-5)+(-3)=-8\), and \(4+(-9)=-5\).
